profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m motivated by understanding, modeling and simplifying complexity. Complexity can come in the form of code, systems, processes, organizations, relationship dynamics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Security (secure-by-design vuln prevention, AI Security) March 2026 - present
Collections Infrastructure (reliability, scalability, performance) Feb 2025 - March 2026

positions.title: Gap year
positions.description: Traveled, took art classes, got back into shape, and volunteered gardening in parks. Had a nice time!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack product development on legacy/core Licensing product. Joined 3 engineers to quickly ship a minimal organization licensing product, reworked data model to allow for role transitions of accounts. React, GraphQL, Rails. Mentorship and technical direction.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managed 2-3 small teams simultaneously, first split between Case Mangement (full stack product team) and platform teams focusing on permission architecture and e-fillable documents architecture. Then shifted to owning only the platform layer including frontend platform. Oversaw re-architecture of online forms, a cleanout of the Rails Pundit policy layer, development of the component library and a remap of information architecture, and much more. 

Point person for hiring and interview processes for much of the time. Introduced a take home technical screen and a new architecture question. Continued to iterate, work with recruiters, and train engineers on interview process.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Grew a new team and product almost from scratch to enable caseworkers to find permanency for children in the foster care system. Hybrid tech lead manager of a small team. Set technical direction for the team, partnered with product to find the right size of solution, hired team members and managed 2-3 direct reports.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: React, Ruby on Rails, Postgres and GCP stack. Full stack web development, with a side of Devops as needed, especially improving release process, incident management, and data warehousing.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: Services SRE: consulted with teams across the company to prepare them for failover, provide canary test tooling for new releases, and improve the platform for service oriented architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Core Desktop Application (login management, installation) -> Release Engineering for Desktop (versioning & release automation & autoupdate infrastructure) -> Desktop Build Infrastructure (continuous integration cluster) -> Databases (MySQL DBRE: tooling, capacity planning, space compaction, failover). Built primarily in Python 2 with gradually rolled out MyPy, with some GoLang and small amounts of React.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed backend Python code for network security products, managed AWS cloud development, stage and production environments, and created internal monitoring dashboards.

positions.title: Science Associate
positions.description: Assisted students in introductory classes with problem solving skills and material. Led help sessions in the evenings, tutored individual students, and graded homework.

positions.title: Student Journalist
positions.description: Researched, wrote, and produced radio stories on the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. Interviewed individuals from the government, military, and affected countries.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Wrote simulations of 2D granular material in Java using Easy Java Simulations, under the advising of Professor Amy Graves and in association with University of Pennsylvania's Liu research group.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher in Biophysics
positions.description: Cultured cells and performed experiments to quantify characteristics of the lipid mixing phase transition of cell membranes. Compared results to simulations based on the Ising model of ferromagnetism in MatLab.
